senses.zh_definition: 特雷弗：源于威尔士的男性名字，也可用作姓氏或地名。
senses.en_definition: A masculine given name of Welsh origin, also used as a surname and place name.
senses.ms_definition: Nama khas asal Wales yang digunakan sebagai nama lelaki, nama keluarga atau nama tempat.
senses.nuances: 通常首字母大写。不能把其历史词源意义直接当作现代马来语词义；没有原文语境时，无法确定具体所指人物或地点。此处马来语释义为编写性说明，并非 DBP 原文。来源：[Behind the Name：Trevor](https://www.behindthename.com/name/trevor)。以下为自然专名组合，不宣称具有已核实的高频统计。

etymology.historical_story: Trevor began as a Welsh surname associated with place names. Its historical elements refer to a settlement and something large, giving the familiar explanation 'large village'. The surname later became a masculine given name in English-speaking communities. That history explains the name; it does not make Trevor a Malay word meaning village. [Source](https://www.behindthename.com/name/trevor)
